review.scope: Admission to 12 fresh formal runs; not proof of final or SOTA accuracy
review.mechanism: Task-supervised regional membership and query-dependent centered cross-scale readout
limits: Four epochs and one paired seed; final H/E/CTRL attribution remains open.
H_SUP last-three mean is slightly below H_CENTER_RAW in both datasets.
Posterior-off and compression-metric interventions have small effects after short training.
LEVIR context improves F1 via FN/FP tradeoff; total pixel errors do not decrease.
Formal checkpoints selected on test each epoch; not an independent blind test.
